description: Take a region of the design in hand so colleagues can see it is held: `contributor_id` claims everything within `depth` hops of `seed_id`. ADVISORY, NEVER A LOCK — it does not block anyone, nothing consults it before a write, and a second person who ignores it still gets a correct three-way merge. It is also only as fresh as the last pull, because the design lives as a file in each checkout with no shared server (dec:multi-writer-architecture). Claims reduce collisions; they do not prevent them. The region is COMPUTED from seed+depth rather than stored as a node list, so it follows the design as it changes. Overlapping an existing claim is allowed and reported by claim_report, never refused.

at.description: Timestamp; the core takes no clock, so the caller supplies it.

contributor_id.description: The `Contributor` taking the region in hand.

depth.description: How far from the seed the region reaches, in hops (default 2).

note.description: Why it is held / what is being done — what a colleague actually wants.

seat.description:
Who is claiming, as a SESSION rather than a person. Pass the handle
`mint_seat` returned; it is a name, never a lock, and it grants no
rights. Omitting it asks the server to use this session's own seat,
which it can only do when the session outlives the request: on the
SESSIONLESS transport (MCP 2026-07-28 and later) a handler is built per
request, so omitting it is REFUSED rather than answered with a seat that
would change on your next call (`dec:stateless-seat-handle`).

seed_id.description: The node the region is computed from.

name: claim_region
